delegates.description: Ordered read-only execution delegates; first definite match wins. Off unless configured.

command.description: Executable and fixed arguments; git argv is appended unchanged. No shell. Relative executable paths resolve against the config directory.

match.description: Must explicitly select effect: read and level: L1; runtime also requires retrySafe.

env.description: Invocation environment: names must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*; all entries must match. Values use path.Match globs; * means set and non-empty (including /); an empty value means unset or empty. Caller-controlled guardrail, not a security boundary.

exitCode.description: Post hooks only: git exit codes (0-255) to run for.

result.description: Post hooks only: success = git exited 0; failure = non-zero exit, killed by a signal, or git could not be started.
